## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Sole conformal class with 0% invasive risk [F1] and clear suggested surgical margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 98%, Benign 1%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Strong Normal call, zero risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal}, α=0.10 (90% coverage) | Single class, 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 72% OOD, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Typical input, passes QC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (true) | Independent models concur |
| Similar cases | 80% (4/5 Normal; 1 Benign) [F5] | Neighbors mostly match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 5) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.53 (-0.61 contribution), caption mismatch, 18/20 check [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.05 (-0.59 contribution), 0/20 check, unreliable [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.28 (-0.32 contribution), weak, 0/20 check, unreliable [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.08 (-0.32 contribution), 20/20 AI check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive risk above random (+0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 stain degradation on this simulated frozen section masks benign mimics (89%-similar Benign BACH_0049) or atypia.
- Sub-threshold signals in region 8 (2% risk, 0.67 invasion) or inferior/medial margins (64%/54%) reflect focal disease.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9**: Inspect highest risk (2%), invasion (0.67), and inferior/medial margin segments (64%, 54%).
2. **Regions 7, 8, 9**: Verify benign stroma/fat and two-layered lobules directly; lobule concept is unreliable (0/20).
3. **Regions 1, 2, 5**: Confirm tubules and region 1 lymphocytes differing from Benign contrast case BACH_0049.
